name: Şube KDV Raporu
query:
SELECT
    h.hesap_adi as "KDV Kalemi::250",
    SUM(IFNULL(gl.borc, 0)) as "Borç:Currency:120",
    SUM(IFNULL(gl.alacak, 0)) as "Alacak:Currency:120",
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN h.hesap_kodu LIKE '191%' THEN IFNULL(gl.borc, 0) - IFNULL(gl.alacak, 0)
        ELSE IFNULL(gl.alacak, 0) - IFNULL(gl.borc, 0)
    END) as "Net Tutar:Currency:120"

FROM
    `tabMuhasebe Defteri` gl
LEFT JOIN
    `tabHesap` h ON h.name = gl.hesap

WHERE
    gl.firma = %(company)s
    AND gl.sube = %(branch)s
    AND (h.hesap_kodu LIKE '191%' OR h.hesap_kodu LIKE '391%')
    AND gl.tarih >= %(from_date)s
    AND gl.tarih <= %(to_date)s

GROUP BY
    h.name
